desc:
EARLY RELEASE: this game is still being built - expect some bugs and new updates often!

CODES (ROBUX SHOP, scroll down): like + favorite the game and join our group to use them!
RELEASE, UPDATE, BUGS, BUGFIX, SORRYFORBUGS, NEXT

Kaiju are coming out of the sea. Stop them!

Pilot a giant ragdoll mech and fight monster waves with real physics. Punch, grab, throw and smash kaiju through buildings - the whole city breaks apart.

MECHS
- Cipsy Dagger: chain sword finishers, plasma beam, rocket elbows
- Coyote Tangle: twin shoulder cannons, EnergyCaster blast, throwdown
- Black Alpha: hydraulic fists, piston grab, hydraulic dropkick
- Red Tsunami: saw claws, Thundercloud, gut saw
- Bravo Guardian: whip snare, electric whip
- Plus Titan, Scorpion, Agility, Ripper, Mace and more

Squad up with friends - every match gets its own server. Earn scrap, open mech packs and unlock wave checkpoints. Works on PC, phone and console.

Made by Jadyboy467 & EZMON107.
